headline: Product Manager | Healthcare and AI Products | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: Product builder with deep healthcare roots. Founder of Roovero, an AI-powered SaaS product I took from discovery to launch and now iterate with paying pilot clients, building hands-on with AI tools. Four years at Greenway Health shaping EHR products, including clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR. MBBS-trained physician with emergency, ICU and teleconsultation experience, so I understand where patients struggle to reach care and what safe, trustworthy AI in healthcare requires.
greenway_bullets: Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas and user goals, mapped end-to-end clinical workflows and identified where agentic automation could remove clinician burden.
Turned clinician needs into UX designs and interactive React prototypes built with AI tools, aligning product, engineering and clients before engineering handoff.
Advised product and design teams on a platform serving 100+ enrolled practices; many features I shaped or advocated for shipped to clients with positive feedback.

Owned implementations for close to 200 client practices: ran discovery on pain points, configured practice-specific workflows, trained 200+ providers, NPs, nurses and medical assistants, and turned recurring friction into feature requests the product team built.
Patient Safety Committee, Functional Advisory Committee and Clinical Content Team: triaged defects and patient safety issues through stage-gate release.
Presented product and AI feature concepts to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: discovery, user research, journey mapping, personas, requirements, prioritisation, prototyping, experimentation and iteration, stakeholder alignment, go-to-market
multi-model integration and routing, prompt design, evaluation rubrics, agentic workflow scoping, AI safety in clinical contexts
React, Flutter, Firebase, Next.js, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub, n8n, Razorpay billing and webhooks
